# PiTTy 0.6.51

## MCP hover no longer shifts the sidebar

- Hovering the sidebar MCP row now floats a tooltip-style card with the server names to its left — like an HTML tooltip — instead of expanding inline rows beneath it. Subagents, Todo, and Notifications stay exactly where they are while the card is visible.
- The card shows connected servers in adapter mode, or enabled servers with a Pi-manages-connections note in built-in mode, capped at six names plus an overflow line. Moving the pointer away hides it.

Run `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.51` to stage the release. It activates on your next PiTTy launch.
